title: Hearty Syrian Lamb Pie
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring shortcrust pastry and flavorful lamb, this pie is a hearty and adventurous meal option. It is also FODMAP-friendly and made with temper to enhance the flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the onion until it is translucent.
Add the garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb to the pan and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Roll out the shortcrust pastry and place it in a pie dish.
Fill the pastry with the lamb mixture and brush the edges with temper.
Roll out the remaining pastry and use it to cover the pie, crimping the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top of the pie to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
